1700.author: Jianyu010
1700.body:
Refs #767.

## 测试夹具

G03 SQLite 反例与已有 Domains 套件共用测试夹具。夹具从原可信源码复制已登记的 transition source 和依赖，由现有 admission loader 形成临时有效清单，然后用原 Domains CLI 扫描原用例。缺少扫描报告时保留退出码和 stderr。六个 SQLite 用例、SQL 断言和原套件选择保持。仅三个测试夹具路径发生变更，生产装配、scanner、策略与 Store schema 均保留。

## 固定源码验证

- 基线 `d47d3d6cfc6489f745b2846cd59950de2ce34175`。Python 3.13.13 运行 `python3.13 -B -m unittest -v tests.server.st.test_store_authority`，六项到达实际 SQLite 后均在解析扫描报告前 ERROR。原普通清单缺少 transition adapter ownership，原 scanner 退出 2。
- 候选 `a8866502cbb35b2a3a402c779f7b7515b7655143`，tree `fba96258ad499dc5956ada98dca2c93c7a5661d1`。同命令获得 **5 PASS / 1 FAIL**，五项反例各有独立归因的预期 AR03 或 AR09。参与方为真实 canonical Store 公开代理、文件 SQLite 和原 Domains CLI，调用者是明确标识的测试夹具。已完成独立复核。
- 合法 Manager 调用通过真实 Store 写入及重开读回，扫描断言仍 FAIL。全检查范围保留五条源代码 AR03 `<dynamic SQL>`。四条来自同一 Hive Store 用固定字符串片段构造的只读 Home 投影，一条来自 Hive routing transaction 内的真实建表。完整 Domains 35 项复验保留基线已有的 3 项失败，transition 夹具 4 项通过。 [#1650](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1650) · [#1243](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1243)
- 发布前实际 main `14a95298b3d8d017c27e027cb6060f068aa3c0f7` 仅增加 #1697 的三份 QA 文档。候选三方合成无冲突，tree `ea55d251f06c46cc23fa02670cf51333c01ce6be`。上面的测试回执归各自固定源码。

## 待处理

- Session Store owner 同 architecture policy owner 复核 `HiveStore` 的四个固定 `SELECT`，保留参数绑定与已支持的 Home 结果投影。Hive routing 和 Store owner 确认 `dm_hive_routing_intents` 建表、更新和删除的持久域及公开装配边界。 [只读投影起点](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/d47d3d6cfc6489f745b2846cd59950de2ce34175/harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/session_proximity/hive_store.py#L1815) · [建表点](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/d47d3d6cfc6489f745b2846cd59950de2ce34175/harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/session_proximity/hive_routing.py#L54)
- 正式 `store-authority` selector 仍为 NOT_ENROLLED。原生 CI、全量 server、真实运行时 final-publication、实际合入后 main、test-3、生产和客户端均未执行。保持 Draft，#767 及其完整门禁保持开放。

1702.author: Jianyu010
1702.body:
Refs #769 and #1486.

### Changes

- Exercise the Hive Bridge's `/ws` with `orbit.request` and `/digitalmate/ws` with `digitalmate.request` using the same retained terminal Home receipt after reopening one frozen pre-cutover SQLite workspace. Both aliases deny missing and incorrect instance tokens before a receipt read.
- Inject one SQLite read failure at the Store owner operation. The old socket returns a request-correlated `RECEIPT_UNKNOWN` with `accepted: false` and `retryable: false`. The current socket then returns the original Task and conversation association and its visible history. Assert the retained row and separate queued Task persist and the Hive admission, model and retired execution sentinels stay silent.
- Document the checkout test in the verification index. The prior #1486 result used the old Manager path and exercised a terminal receipt whose associated Task was pending. Hive's current code replays receipts associated with a `completed` or `accepted` Task, so this case exercises the retained completed Task. The earlier result and its original fault behavior retain their original scope.

### Evidence

- Base `d47d3d6cfc6489f745b2846cd59950de2ce34175`, exact candidate `9d4969f9e1f26a723dbc133db474fffe42c360e1`, tree `00c539323c8550f5f1b97be977683f9e2de3021b`. A trial merge against main `c0fb45e6a098a616ab908c51f4605f4d7f3274fb` was clean (tree `087f13ee3ad98c3252342f9e3b6769c501feab9c`). Intervening scenario documentation and the architecture-artifact workflow do not change the inspected replay path. The candidate and source receipts remain pinned to their own revisions.
- Local CPython 3.13.13 on macOS arm64, `pytest -q -ra -p no:cacheprovider` across `test_hive_startup_fence.py`, `test_digitalmate_protocol.py` and `test_hive_legacy_execution_fence.py` passed 18/18 in 6.06s, with zero failures or skips. The local environment reported an unavailable pytest timeout plugin. Source imports used the registry paths and the Bridge's Beebou package mapping. The verification link resolved, and `git diff --check` passed.
- Independent review and checkout rerun passed the new case on exact `9d4969f9` (1/1 in 4.08s on Python 3.13.13 and pytest 9.1.1), with no P1 or P2 found. Participants were the configured Bridge, both aiohttp loopback WebSockets, the production Manager, receipt decoder and SQLite Store, a temporary legacy fixture, a controlled owner-read failure and the scripted backend/model and execution sentinels.

### Remaining verification

This draft carries a sourced test slice. The protected installed server run and collector under #1014, applicable native CI, production Gateway, test-3 and signed HAP/device checks are `NOT_RUN` for this candidate. The supported compatibility matrix and full retirement evidence stay with #769. #1486 and #1685 retain their original candidate heads and receipts.

1703.author: Jianyu010
1703.body:
Refs #1660

## What
A quick reply that voices progress on earlier work without naming a subject noun ("等我这边把周报的事收个尾，马上开始安排…") passed the #1641 guard, because that guard needs a clause with both an `absence_subjects` noun and a `running_claims` phrase.

This adds a second rule to `review_quick_text` (`harness/quick.py`, `_claims_progress`). A clause holding a **progress phrase** is refused as `task_state_mismatch` on its own, under the same precondition as the existing rule: `active_tasks == 0`, or an earlier input of the session is uncommitted (`pending`). The existing two-list rule is unchanged.

- Phrases and patterns are in `config/quick_reply.toml` (`progress_phrases`, `progress_patterns`), loaded and validated in `config/settings.py`:
  - literals: 收个尾, 收尾, 忙完, 弄完, 手头的事 (and variants), wrapping up, finishing up, about to finish
  - patterns: `等我这边.{0,20}?(完|尾|好)`, `wrap(s) up`, `finish(es) up`, `almost/nearly done|finished|through`
- A clause is the text between punctuation, as for the existing guard.
- No negation or future qualifier exempts a progress phrase. A refusal is fail-safe: the user keeps the plain "accepted" receipt and the normal turn still runs.
- Out of scope, per the coordinator's decision: "记下了" is an acknowledgement, not a progress claim. No follow-up opened.

## Which precondition FOLLOW-04 r3 T2 hit
The trace (`artifacts/hive-live/pr1641-b9ff090a/...`) isn't in the repository, so I did not read it. Per the coordinator, the trace's task view had `active_tasks=0` (the weekly-report task was completed), so **precondition 1 (`active_tasks == 0`) is the one that hit**. The review (F1) shows the text is admitted today under `active_tasks=0`, `pending=True` and both, so both preconditions are tested.

## Tests (`temp/hive-beebou/tests/test_beebou_quick_reply.py`, enrolled `test_beebou_*.py`)
- `test_review_refuses_subjectless_progress_wording_the_task_view_does_not_show`: the reported text and 10 other phrasings are refused under `active_tasks=0`, `pending`, `pending`+active, and both; admitted with an active task or no view. Also pins that the reported text is admitted at `active_tasks=1`.
- `test_review_admits_ordinary_wording_that_is_no_progress_claim`: "我马上开始安排" and similar are admitted under every precondition. The user's own wording echoed back is admitted when no earlier task exists (view shows a task, or no view).
- `test_review_keeps_the_two_list_rule_beside_the_progress_rule`: the #1618/#1641 behaviour is unchanged.
- `test_quick_reply_refuses_the_reported_progress_text_from_the_hosts_task_view`: through `run_quick` with the Host's task-view message (completed only) and with the pending note.

## Verification
- `test_beebou_*.py` in `temp/hive-beebou/tests` (Python 3.13, pytest installed in a scratch venv): 39 tests OK, 1 skipped; the existing #1618/#1641 tests pass.
- Not run locally: `tests/scenarios/hive/test_phase2_quick_reply.py` and `test_phase3_quick_absence_pending.py` (they need `server_engine`, not available here). I grepped `tests/scenarios/hive`, `tests/eval/hive-live` and `temp/hive-*/tests` for the new phrases: no other quick text contains them. CI runs the scenarios.
- Acceptance is a live QA rerun of HIVE-LIVE-FOLLOW-04. This PR does not close #1660.

1704.author: Jianyu010
1704.body:
Refs #1653

## What
After a dispatch is accepted, Beebou could burn its 12-call `max_model_calls` budget on read-only rounds and settle the turn as a generic harness failure, although the Bee already had the task.

- **Budget exit:** `BeebouHarness.run` now ends with the accepted-dispatch receipt instead of raising when it reaches `max_model_calls` with an accepted dispatch (`status: accepted` with `message_id` and `task_ref`). With no accepted dispatch it still raises as before.
- **Read-only cap:** once a dispatch is accepted, at most `[normal_turn] max_readonly_rounds_after_dispatch` (default 2) further read-only rounds run (`list_bees` and the `readonly_tools` allowlist count). The next one is not run: the turn commits the receipt. Another accepted dispatch restarts the count; reads before the first one are not capped.
- **Wording:** the receipt `已将任务交给 Bee 处理。` moves into the new `temp/hive-beebou/src/dm_hive_beebou/config/normal_turn.toml` as `accepted_receipt` (same default). Both keys are required, with no code fallback. The file is separate from `quick_reply.toml`, which the #1660 lane owns.
- **Contract:** the decisions are a new row in `docs/implementations/contracts/beebou-hive-phase3-delivery.md` §7a.

## Verification
Source: commit `0c06496e8` on main `c0fb45e6`; origin/main was merged in afterwards and the suites were not rerun on the merge. Python 3.13 venv, real `BeebouHarness`; the model and Host tools are scripted in the unit tests. The service-level tests use the real Store, Registry, tool guard, Bot Repository and `HiveTurnStartup`, with a controlled model.
- `temp/hive-beebou/tests`: 121 passed. New: `test_beebou_dispatch_receipt.py` covers dispatch then N reads ending with the receipt and one commit; the budget reached with and without an accepted dispatch; the cap at 0, 1, 3 and 5; the configured wording; host-granted read-only tools; a mixed round and the count restart; the Bee-terminal text; and the loader checks.
- `agent_bridge/tests/test_hive_*.py`: 450 passed, 3 skipped, 7 xfailed. New: `test_hive_beebou_dispatch_receipt.py` shows a `committed` turn with the receipt, no failure row and one task, and a read-only loop with no dispatch still settling as a harness failure.
- Not run: the server-ut-st sandbox and the live QA.

## Acceptance
The live QA repeats of HIVE-LIVE-EVICT-04 and HIVE-LIVE-EVICT-06. #1653 stays open until then.

1706.author: Jianyu010
1706.body:
## Scope

Refs #1569 and #1575. This draft receives the federated-source startup slice for review. A05 worker source roots, Hosted MCP selection, the queued-factory assertion and the original configured-runtime proof stay open under their existing scopes.

- Resolve each memory provider's explicit root first, then Engine HOME/USERPROFILE, then the OS home. If the OS cannot resolve a required home, the unconfigured memory providers have no listable resources and the project-file reader stays available.
- Preserve the existing WebSocket BAD_PARAMS envelope when an unconfigured provider cannot resolve its root. The Bridge error stays distinct from a missing document under a known root. The current Brief/Store owner continues to tombstone a genuinely missing file.
- Preserve registered Claude and Codex source rows and dependent tasks through temporary home loss. With HOME restored, original IDs, document revisions and brief text remain readable through the same public Engine requests.

## Evidence

- Development base d47d3d6cfc6489f745b2846cd59950de2ce34175, reviewed head 1b7d75b7440b423e482c6cb2176c26f6e3ba2413, tree ccafcd19ea7c1c7b3d2d9c866e32643e93411b92. Independent exact source review found no blocking issue after the preservation regression. At PR preparation, main d1fb236d had no changed path among this slice's Bridge, Engine, brief and source files or targeted test files.
- Python 3.13.13, nine source tests and three actual Engine brief tests passed. The new Engine regression uses real request handlers and temporary SQLite. Both provider cases compare the complete stored source, task and signal state during HOME loss, then re-register the original ID/content and re-read the same brief. An actual unlink below the restored root still produces the original deleted marker.
- Configured Bridge and Engine startup passed with a controlled OS home lookup failure, no Engine HOME/USERPROFILE, real temporary workspace SQLite and an authenticated instance-mode loopback WebSocket. A request for the unavailable Codex provider returned the original correlated BAD_PARAMS envelope, and a project source remained readable. The backend was ScriptedBackend. The model, vendor and production Gateway were outside this run.
- The exact d47 architecture checker and policy scanned 523 source files, checked 281, loaded 11 transition registrations and returned zero findings. Diff whitespace check passed.
- Negative controls remain associated with their own sources. At d47 before the startup fix, two source cases threw at Path.home and actual configured Bridge startup reproduced the exception. At initial 642e38cf before the preservation fix, the tested Brief path mutated both provider records. The harness run with host HOME inherited was corrected to suppress host HOME/USERPROFILE and root overrides. Early fixture comparisons of full response snapshots included legitimate task/record revision changes, so the final round checks stable wire fields and complete durable state while HOME is absent.

## Pending

Component-owner acceptance, ordinary native checks and the protected isolated configured-runtime run remain pending. Original A05 acceptance stays in its documented scope. Test-3, production Gateway and T1/HAP verification were outside this run.

1707.author: Jianyu010
1707.body:
Refs #767. 与 [夹具修复 #1700](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/pull/1700) 分开交付。

## Store 只读投影

原 HiveStore 的 Home 提交列表、消息位置、首页及续页仍各执行原 SQL。固定在各自调用点的完整 SQL 保留原两个模块字符串片段展开后的所有字符。保留原作用域和游标参数绑定、选择和排序、读取次数、返回值与 Store writer。两处模块级片段已移除，Store 模块文档记录当前实现。 [Store 模块](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/24bc6846b4cc74a2a4ec4695151d83cce0a0bfaf/docs/implementations/modules/server-agent-service-session-store-v3.1.md)

## 验证

- 开发及测试基线 `d1fb236d14977aa1fd17cbe826eb3b0c7259007f`，候选 `24bc6846b4cc74a2a4ec4695151d83cce0a0bfaf`，tree `e45e22da197f957335f53465fd436c5196c97bde`。AST 复核确认四条完整 SQL 逐字相等。替换四个表达式并移除两处原定义后，HiveStore 整文件 AST 相等。
- 两侧使用相同的十项现有 Home、混合历史及 H-C7 pytest 用例，各 10/10。独立复查三个 Home/混合历史用例通过。真实参与方为 CLI Bridge、`/digitalmate/ws`、Home 协议、Beebou、Hive Store 和实际文件 SQLite，包含每侧同卷重开及 Node 运行的原 ArkTS 模型。模型端点、Bee 运行时和 ScriptedBackend 按原用例受控。另以只读方式在同一测试生成文件执行旧/新四条 SQL 与相同参数，结果逐值相同，行数 4/1/2/2，SQLite authorizer 仅观察读操作。
- 原 import/ownership 检查扫描 523 个文件，强检查 281 个，零 findings。原 Domains 使用相同 admitted inventory 对照两侧，五条 AR03 变为一条。保留现有 `HiveRoutingIntents.open` 的实际 DDL finding。与 #1700 的本地合成 tree `8454a9df73e1aa8a963f6e258857699c040de027` 原 G03 六项为五项反例通过、一项合法用例 FAIL，该 DDL 为唯一剩余诊断。 [当前建表入口](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/d1fb236d14977aa1fd17cbe826eb3b0c7259007f/harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/session_proximity/hive_routing.py#L54)
- 与 #1688 的独立三方合成无冲突，tree `672f3f8ac884cf5c6a4c86247259f2d9c27c8bdc`。该合成未用于上列运行。

## 待验收

保留 Draft。完整 #767 仍 FAIL，正式 `store-authority` 未登记。原生 CI、全量 server、真实 final publication、独立性能量测、test-3、实际合入后的 main、生产 Gateway 和 T1/HAP 均未运行。
